$comment: Settings for the PRODUCT REPO — the tree that holds your code.
This is the second half of the workspace. The workspace repo has its own .claude/settings.json;
this one exists so that an agent launched from INSIDE your code directory still gets the same
hooks, the same model tier and the same refusals. Two settings files, one behaviour — and
scripts/check.mjs compares them and fails when they drift, because a hook that runs in one
tree and not the other is worse than no hook: the gate appears to exist.
REPLACE `../WORKSPACE` with the actual relative path from this repo to the workspace repo.
If you cloned the workspace as a sibling directory named NexaClaude-Code-Workspace-Setup,
If your code lives INSIDE the workspace (in code/), you do not need this file at all — the
workspace's own settings already cover it.
model + MAX_THINKING_TOKENS are pinned deliberately. See AGENTS.md — 'the tier is not a
choice'. A cheaper model on the review path is how a review becomes a formality.

hooks.command: node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../WORKSPACE/scripts/hooks/session-start.mjs" 2>/dev/null || echo '⚠ workspace not found beside this repo — board gates are OFF. See ../WORKSPACE/SETUP.md'
